CREATE TABLE qt_v4.artifacts (
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, kind, entity_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.audit_events (
	sequence BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sequence)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.campaign_dataset_guards (
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	dataset_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, dataset_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.campaign_holdout_grants (
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	campaign_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	grant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	granted_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, campaign_id), 
	UNIQUE (grant_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.experiment_campaigns (
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	campaign_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	dataset_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	holdout_start_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	holdout_end_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	candidate_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, campaign_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_campaign_bounds CHECK (holdout_end_ns > holdout_start_ns AND candidate_limit > 0)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.experiment_trials (
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	trial_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	campaign_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	result JSON, 
	result_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, trial_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.forecast_records (
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	forecast_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	event_cluster_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	decision_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, forecast_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.jobs (
	job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	deadline_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	lease_until_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	lease_token VARCHAR(64), 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	result JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (job_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_v4_job_identity UNIQUE (tenant_id, kind, idempotency_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_v4_job_attempts CHECK (attempts >= 0)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.migration_imports (
	source_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	manifest JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (source_hash, tenant_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.model_calls (
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	call_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	periods JSON NOT NULL, 
	reserved NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	actual NUMERIC(38, 18), 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, call_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.risk_accounts (
	account_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	quote_asset VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	capital NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	reserved_quote NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	daily_new_risk NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	day_utc VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	lease_token VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_owner VARCHAR(160), 
	lease_until_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reconciled_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (account_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_v4_risk_amounts CHECK (CAST(capital AS NUMERIC) > 0 AND CAST(reserved_quote AS NUMERIC) >= 0)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.runtime_health (
	name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	observed_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (name, tenant_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.schema_versions (
	version SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (version)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.usage_budgets (
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	period VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	reserved NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	maximum NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, period)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.forecast_resolution_events (
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	resolution_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	forecast_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, resolution_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, forecast_id) REFERENCES qt_v4.forecast_records (tenant_id, forecast_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_v4_forecast_resolution_revision UNIQUE (tenant_id, forecast_id, revision)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.ledger_transactions (
	transaction_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (transaction_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_v4_ledger_source UNIQUE (account_id, kind, source_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES qt_v4.risk_accounts (account_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.orders (
	intent_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	deployment_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	signal_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	leg_no INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	venue VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	instrument VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	side VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	filled_quantity NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	reserved_quote NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	reserved_base NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	risk_reservation_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	settlement_status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	venue_order_id VARCHAR(200), 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	updated_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	last_reconciled_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (intent_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_v4_signal_leg UNIQUE (account_id, deployment_id, signal_id, leg_no), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_v4_order_quantity CHECK (CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC) > 0 AND CAST(filled_quantity AS NUMERIC) >= 0 AND CAST(filled_quantity AS NUMERIC) <= CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES qt_v4.risk_accounts (account_id), 
	UNIQUE (risk_reservation_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.portfolio_snapshots (
	snapshot_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	observed_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	market_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (snapshot_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES qt_v4.risk_accounts (account_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.risk_state (
	account_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	policy_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	day_utc VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	day_start_equity NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	high_water_equity NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	last_equity NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	last_mark_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	market JSON NOT NULL, 
	latched_reasons JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (account_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES qt_v4.risk_accounts (account_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.fills (
	fill_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	intent_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	venue VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	venue_trade_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	price NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	fee NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	fee_asset VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_ns BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (fill_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_v4_venue_fill UNIQUE (venue, account_id, venue_trade_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_v4_fill_amounts CHECK (CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC) > 0 AND CAST(price AS NUMERIC) > 0 AND CAST(fee AS NUMERIC) >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(intent_id) REFERENCES qt_v4.orders (intent_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES qt_v4.risk_accounts (account_id)
)


CREATE TABLE qt_v4.ledger_entries (
	entry_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	transaction_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	asset VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	bucket VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(38, 18) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (entry_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id) REFERENCES qt_v4.ledger_transactions (transaction_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES qt_v4.risk_accounts (account_id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_v4_events_entity ON qt_v4.audit_events (tenant_id, entity_id, sequence)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_forecast_cluster ON qt_v4.forecast_records (tenant_id, event_cluster_id, decision_ns)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_jobs_claim ON qt_v4.jobs (kind, status, lease_until_ns, created_ns)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_calls_run ON qt_v4.model_calls (tenant_id, run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_account_tenant ON qt_v4.risk_accounts (tenant_id, account_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_forecast_resolution ON qt_v4.forecast_resolution_events (tenant_id, forecast_id, revision)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_ledger_account ON qt_v4.ledger_transactions (account_id, created_ns)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_orders_account ON qt_v4.orders (account_id, status)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_orders_tenant ON qt_v4.orders (tenant_id, intent_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_portfolio_snapshots ON qt_v4.portfolio_snapshots (tenant_id, account_id, observed_ns)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_fill_account ON qt_v4.fills (account_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_fill_intent ON qt_v4.fills (intent_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_entries_balance ON qt_v4.ledger_entries (account_id, asset, bucket)
CREATE INDEX ix_v4_entries_tx ON qt_v4.ledger_entries (transaction_id)
